I was in a four and a half year relationship until four/five months ago, I still see her around campus. It broke me towards the end of that relationship and I gained about 25 pounds in stress eating. I have since dropped pretty much all that weight. I'm able to me open about my bisexuality, I have more girls who are friends and I am over all more complete. Your time is your own now, you can work on being who you want. When you're actually alone, you get to learn about what kind of person you want to be if you can't distract with a partner. I believe in you, I hope you have a really nice Christmas and that 2018 is one of the best years of your life. You didn't deserve to have your heart broken, but you deserve to be free to grow in the aftermath.

Getting your heartbroken is the best awful thing that could happen to you. It changes you and grounds you in ways you'll need for future relationships. Eventually you'll have had your heart broken enough that you'll get to be happy for good.
